fields.statement: At f73688bd I ran go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/api -run TestWatchdogPolicy -v: PASS, with subtests for the defaults (enabled, 20m/40m nudge/retry, 30m command, 90m wait, retryBudget 2, ciReruns 1, pollBehind 3, fileBugs and autonomousOnly true), a machine value under [daemon] in rhiza.toml, a rhiza.project.watchdog.* git config key over the machine key, a workflow step's stall field winning for that step, and invalid values rejected with their key named. go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(watchdog-policy|describe-golden|daemon)': PASS. go test ./internal/workflow: PASS. With a scratch build in a fresh repo, rhiza daemon settings listed all 10 rhiza.daemon.watchdog.* keys as (default, machine) and the 9 rhiza.project.watchdog.* keys (no pollBehind) as (default, project). The settings, daemon-set and autonomy tests in internal/api pass. The whole internal/api package hit its 600s timeout at load 16, in an unrelated database/sql goroutine dump. I read the diff: the keys join settingDefs in init, the resolver takes project over machine over default, and stall is a positive step duration that a workflow-kind step rejects.
